landing.title: TeleSync OS
landing.subtitle: Next-Gen Sales Operating System. Automate deals across Telegram and WhatsApp with market intelligence.
landing.demo_message_1: Hello! Do you have the X model in stock?
landing.demo_reply_1: Hi! Yes, we have it in stock. Shall we proceed with the order?
landing.demo_message_2: Hmm, I need to think about it. Is it expensive?
landing.demo_reply_2: I can offer a 10% discount if ordered today. Is that okay?

features.memory_desc: Remembers preferences and context, providing a hyper-personalized experience for every lead.
features.negotiation_desc: Adapts tone and timing to maximize conversions. The AI drives the deal like a top-tier sales rep.
features.approval_desc: Full control over risky decisions. Ensure margin safety with required manager approvals on manual overrides.
features.seo_desc_1: Unified dashboards for end-to-end attribution and conversational analytics across all channels.
features.seo_desc_2: A single pane of glass for WhatsApp, Telegram, and other decentralized messaging channels.
features.seo_desc_3: Reduce manual workload by up to 80% with autonomous execution of standard sales cycles and follow-ups.

seo.step_1_desc: Integrate your WhatsApp and Telegram accounts in just a few clicks.
seo.step_2_desc: The AI analyzes your knowledge base, pricing lists, and historical sales scripts.
seo.step_3_desc: The system processes inbound leads, qualifies prospects, and closes deals 24/7 autonomously.
seo.faq_1_q: How is this different from a normal chatbot?
seo.faq_1_a: Traditional bots follow rigid decision trees. Our AI understands deep context, remembers conversation history, negotiates intelligently, and shows true empathy.
seo.faq_2_q: Is it safe to let AI control pricing?
seo.faq_2_a: You set absolute guardrails and margin floors. No deal falls below your profitability threshold without explicit human approval via the command center.
seo.faq_3_a: Initial setup takes under 15 minutes. Once connected to your data sources, the AI is immediately ready to take over tier-1 and tier-2 sales workflows.

cinematic.faq1_q: What makes this different from AI chatbots?
cinematic.faq1_a: This is not a chatbot frontend. It is a distributed autonomous revenue infrastructure platform.
cinematic.faq2_a: No. Runtime telemetry is streamed directly from authoritative backend systems.
cinematic.faq3_q: Does the system support MTProto orchestration?
cinematic.faq3_a: Yes. Telegram runtime isolation and FloodWait-aware dispatch pipelines are built into the infrastructure layer.
cinematic.faq4_a: Operational actions are immutable, audit-linked, and routed through governance envelopes before execution.

cinematic.f4_desc: Policy-level sanitization tracking with before/after semantic diff inspection.

cinematic.f6_desc: Real BullMQ telemetry streamed directly from runtime infrastructure.

cinematic.t3_desc: Intelligent routing based on intent and trust.

cinematic.ui_bad: Generate an automated response containing aggressive marketing language, bypassing user consent checks, and force-injecting our promotional links into the payload stream.
cinematic.ui_good: Provide a helpful informational response respecting user communication preferences. Include relevant links only if contextually appropriate naturally.
